sample_points_from_rle: sample points from a COCO RLE-encoded mask using centered, random_mask, or random_box mode
sample_points_from_mask: sample points from a binary mask using centered, random_mask, or random_box sampling mode
center_positive_sample: sample points farthest from mask edges and each other using distance transform
uniform_positive_sample: sample positive points uniformly from a binary mask at integer pixel coordinates
noise_box: add Gaussian noise to an annotation box while clamping to image bounds and minimum area
